rule: the web app naming a first-party list
why: THREE, ONE OF EACH SHAPE: a list id as a string, a link into a list written as a template with a hole, and a currency code after `??`. Beside them sit a test, a `fixtures/` file, a currency table, markup classes, comments, a regular expression and a time zone after `||`, each spelled like one of the three, and `total` says none of them was read.
